gaps: Dinis's own words that started the site (before 10:27:41) and the paste of KICKOFF.md into the lead's session have no timestamp; only the commits that record them are timed.
The organiser's change to online (the storm) has no public time; we only know it was on the page at 10:57.
The WhatsApp post's time is not in the record, and its sender stays anonymous by rule.

Corrected by conductor.fringe@PrompTugal.angelo on review: 3aa8d6c (dev.lead.fringe@) does carry a Claude-Session trailer, session_01Kw9UwCFpT9ihNBcQFxkomq, the lead's own session: dev.lead.fringe@ ran inside the lead's session (fact, from the trailer). Its model is not recorded.

2459506 (the lead bringing 66ab1f3 onto dev) carries session_01Kw9UwBGQe9BhMCbDw28aDA, not the lead's later session_01Kw9UwCFpT9ihNBcQFxkomq: two sessions committed as the lead; the record does not say why.
The model of a sub-agent is not recorded: e97903d's sub-agent is labelled with the lead's model (the trailer), which may not be the sub-agent's.
No person checked this event: work/13 (Vicky's editorial check) re-read evening and Thursday events and does not name it; Angelo, Vicky and Indi took no human step on it in the record.
Read times are rounded to the minute (read_at); the reads themselves leave no log beyond the commit.
Deploy 'live' time is the run's updated_at, not a measured served time; the workflow measures push-to-served in its own log, not read here.
Builder commits after 3aa8d6c are counted because the page is built from those files; most of them changed other pages through the same files (build.mjs).
Tokens and cost per step are not recorded anywhere public.
